No horizontal scrolling and no undersized buttons on the live site at 390 px or 1280 px. Before deploy, a pixel comparison showed only the intended visual changes, with the scan-intake form and Companion sign-in unchanged.

expected: Faster, more reliable indexing from the sitemap, canonical URLs and robots.txt.
Richer, page-specific previews when links are shared in Instagram DMs, Facebook, iMessage, WhatsApp, LinkedIn and X.
Clearer entity understanding of Kay Joy Flowers, her book and her services in Google and AI answer engines, from consistent Person, Book, Product and Service markup.
Eligibility for breadcrumb display in Google results. FAQ rich results are now shown mainly for government and health sites, so the FAQ markup mainly helps AI answers.
unmeasurable: Rankings, impressions, clicks or AI citations: no change can be measured until the site is live and Google Search Console has data (allow 2–6 weeks after deploy).
Beacons checkout pages: blocked to automated visitors (Cloudflare), so they need a manual click-through.
Stripe payment link prices: the connected Stripe account isn't the one that holds the scan links, so prices couldn't be read by API. The links return HTTP 200.
lighthouse_note: Both columns were measured on the live site: before on 17 November (UTC), after deployment on 17/18 November, with Lighthouse 12, mobile, simulated throttling and the median of 3 runs. Accessibility and best practices are now 100 on every page. The Library page's largest paint dropped from 3.50 s to 1.76 s, and the About page from 1,043 KB to 123 KB. On Fearlessly Unfuckwithable the cover image is now loaded eagerly and is the largest element, so LCP is 1.89 s instead of 1.81 s. That is within run-to-run variation, and performance stays at 98.

deployment_detail: Live. On Kay's instruction, main was fast-forwarded from 116b245 to eadf317 (no merge commit, no force-push). GitHub Pages' built-in 'pages build and deployment' run #20 succeeded, and the new files were live within a minute. Every published file was then fetched from kayjoyflowers.online and matched byte for byte against a local build of main. The live audit, Lighthouse and screenshots above come from the deployed site. To roll back, revert the merge range on main (or reset it to 116b245) and GitHub Pages redeploys automatically.
